objective: Design climate-aware utility systems for residential buildings. Implement heating demand in cold climates, self-heating capabilities with explicit B2C fuel/electricity purchasing, and self-managed waste/water/sewage mechanics for off-grid buildings that output local Pollution into the environment system (mass conservation — matter cannot disappear). Ensure utility infrastructure (pipes, grids) physically connects parcels to utility networks. All utility pricing must use cost-plus models with CAPEX amortization and smoothed historical volumes.
constraints: RAM protection: cargo check and cargo clippy only
RBAC: no git checkout/switch/reset/rebase/clean
Rule 1: All utility payments must have strict counterparty (resident pays utility company); no fiat creation
Rule 2: Utility tariffs must scale by average_wage and consumption volume, not flat rates
Rule 3: Physical BOM for utility infrastructure must be static; financial costs from market prices
Rule 5: Utility capacity allocation must use market clearing or pro-rata by connected parcel demand
Rule 9: Parcel-to-utility-network linkage must use cadastre index lookups to avoid double mutable borrows
Rule 14: Extend existing utilities/ and energy/ modules; do not create parallel utility infrastructure
Rule 15: Utility consumption (heating, water, waste) must scale by floor_area, occupancy, and climate zone, not flat rates
Rule 16: Utility service sequencing must respect turn order: utility production → B2C fuel purchase → consumption → waste/pollution output → health impact
Rule 17: Utility access, quality, and local pollution from off-grid waste must be visible in UI snapshots
Rule 19: Utility infrastructure must physically connect parcels to utility networks; no teleporting services. Disconnected parcels receive zero utility service.
Rule 20: Utility capacity must have hard limits with overflow (service degradation/rejection) behavior
Rule 21: Municipal utilities must use cost-plus pricing with CAPEX amortization and smoothed historical volumes (24-turn rolling averages)
Rule 22: Do not modify fertilizer, military, sports, or environment modules. Do NOT implement cooperative lifecycles — that is blueprint-007.
Rule 23: Surgically append to utilities/ and energy/ modules; do not overwrite existing utility structs
SCOPE LIMIT: This blueprint ONLY covers climate-aware utility systems (heating, water, waste, sewage) and their physical connection to residential parcels via infrastructure networks.

B2C FUEL PURCHASE: Residents in self-heating buildings MUST explicitly purchase fuel (Coal, Wood, Gas, or Electricity) on the retail market via B2C clearing BEFORE consuming for heat. Resident Labor account debited, fuel supplier (Company) credited. No fuel = no heat = health penalties. Fuel quantity = floor_area * climate_heating_degree_days * thermal_efficiency_coefficient.

MASS CONSERVATION — OFF-GRID WASTE/SEWAGE (v5 rejection fix): 'Self-managed waste/sewage' for off-grid buildings CANNOT make matter disappear. When a building is not connected to the municipal sewer/waste network, its waste and sewage MUST be converted into local Pollution that directly impacts the environment metrics established in blueprint-002. Specifically: (1) Each off-grid building generates waste_mass and sewage_volume proportional to occupancy and floor_area (physical scaling, Rule 15). (2) This waste is NOT collected by municipal services (no connection). (3) Instead, it is emitted as local pollution into the existing LocalPollutionState in environment/smog.rs — increasing smog_level, water_pollution, and soil_contamination for the building's region. (4) The pollution output must use the existing pollution accumulation mechanics (concentration = emissions / region_area). (5) This creates a meaningful trade-off (Rule 18): off-grid buildings save on utility connection costs but generate local pollution that degrades ecological_health (from blueprint-002) and harms resident health. (6) Connected buildings route their waste to municipal treatment plants, which process it properly (no local pollution, but residents pay utility fees). (7) The pollution output must be visible in UI snapshots as offgrid_pollution_contribution per parcel. No matter is created or destroyed — waste becomes pollution.
Use: bash .devin/scripts/request_integration.sh when done

state/src/economy/trade/retail.rs — Add B2C fuel purchase transaction for residential heating: debit resident Labor account, credit fuel supplier Company
state/src/society/cadastre.rs — Add parcel-to-utility-network linkage API (physical connection check)
state/src/energy/ — Integrate heating demand with energy grid for electric heating systems

completion_criteria: Climate-aware utilities implemented with self-heating capabilities. Residents explicitly purchase fuel via B2C retail clearing BEFORE consuming for heat. Off-grid buildings' self-managed waste/sewage output local Pollution into environment/smog.rs LocalPollutionState — mass conservation respected, matter cannot disappear. Connected buildings route waste to municipal treatment (no local pollution). Utility infrastructure physically connects parcels to networks. All utility pricing uses cost-plus with CAPEX amortization. UI snapshots expose utility access data AND off-grid pollution contribution. M0 conservation maintained. Iron CI/CD green.

rejection_reason: Physics Engine Violation (Water from Air). Off-grid buildings cannot generate sewage_volume out of nowhere. They MUST have a local water source (e.g., a well requiring CAPEX) that inputs water before they can output sewage. Define this physical input dependency.
